title: Node utilization (prototype)
description: What ran on one node in the time range, what it asked for, and what the node and each attempt used. Four hub queries per load: the node list and three panel queries.

params.value: SELECT DISTINCT node_name AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE service = 'iris-node-agent' AND name = 'hardware_inventory' AND cluster IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Task attempts on the node
panels.description:
Attempts on ${node} that overlap the time range: their job, the job's request, and its usage category (empty until job tags are written). Attempts whose newest row is older than 1 day before the range start are missed.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH attempt AS ( SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, state, started_at, finished_at FROM (  SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, state, started_at, finished_at,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY attempt_uid ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__task_attempts"  WHERE (node_name = '${node}' OR worker_id = '${node}')   AND ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}} ) WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < {{to}}   AND COALESCE(finished_at, {{to}}) > {{from}}), job AS ( SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, user_id, name FROM (  SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, user_id, name,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__jobs"  WHERE ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}}   AND root_job_id IN (SELECT root_job_id FROM attempt) ) WHERE rn = 1), request AS ( SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, res_cpu_millicores, res_memory_bytes, accelerator_kind, accelerator_type,  accelerators_per_task FROM (  SELECT cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms, res_cpu_millicores, res_memory_bytes, accelerator_kind, accelerator_type,   accelerators_per_task,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__job_config"  WHERE ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}}   AND root_job_id IN (SELECT root_job_id FROM attempt) ) WHERE rn = 1) SELECT a.attempt_uid, a.task_id, a.attempt_id, a.job_id, j.user_id, j.name AS job_name, a.state,  a.started_at, a.finished_at, r.res_cpu_millicores / 1000.0 AS cpu_request,  r.res_memory_bytes AS memory_request_bytes, r.accelerator_kind, r.accelerator_type,  r.accelerators_per_task, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS category FROM attempt a LEFT JOIN job j USING (cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms) LEFT JOIN request r USING (cluster, root_job_id, root_submitted_at_ms, job_id, submitted_at_ms) ORDER BY a.started_at
```

panels.title: GPU SM-active per GPU
panels.description:
Per-minute SM-active ratio of each GPU on ${node} (CoreWeave nodes only). This panel's query also feeds the tensor-active, host CPU and host memory panels.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms), TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS minute, name, json_get(attributes_json, 'gpu_index') AS gpu_index, avg(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.node_agent" WHERE service = 'iris-node-agent' AND node_name = '${node}' AND name IN ('gpu_sm_active_ratio', 'gpu_tensor_active_ratio', 'gpu_power_watts', 'node_cpu_utilization_percent', 'node_memory_used_bytes', 'node_memory_total_bytes') AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
```

panels.title: CPU cores per attempt
panels.description:
Per-minute CPU cores each attempt on ${node} used, from iris.task. This panel's query also feeds the memory panel.

SQL ({{from}} and {{to}} are the dashboard time range; the bridge fills them in.):

```sql
WITH attempt AS ( SELECT cluster, task_id, attempt_id, started_at, finished_at FROM (  SELECT cluster, task_id, attempt_id, attempt_uid, started_at, finished_at,   row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY attempt_uid ORDER BY ts DESC, seq DESC) AS rn  FROM "iris.controller_db__task_attempts"  WHERE (node_name = '${node}' OR worker_id = '${node}')   AND ts >= {{from}} - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < {{to}} ) WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < {{to}}   AND COALESCE(finished_at, {{to}}) > {{from}}) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', t.ts, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01 00:00:00') AS minute,  t.task_id || ':' || CAST(t.attempt_id AS VARCHAR) AS attempt,  avg(t.cpu_millicores) / 1000.0 AS cpu_cores, avg(t.memory_mb) * 1048576 AS memory_bytes FROM "iris.task" t JOIN attempt a  ON COALESCE(NULLIF(t.cluster, ''), 'marin') = a.cluster  AND t.task_id = a.task_id AND t.attempt_id = a.attempt_id  AND t.ts >= a.started_at AND t.ts <= COALESCE(a.finished_at, {{to}}) WHERE t.ts >= {{from}} AND t.ts < {{to}}  AND t.task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM attempt) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
```
